diagnosis: Five metrics are outside their bands and all point the same way: shots_per_team, sot_per_team, goals_per_match and sot_share are too high, and ball_in_play_min is slightly high. These are driven by chance creation and restart dead-time. Useful dials: LOSS, RESIST_FINAL_THIRD, RESIST_SHOOTING_RANGE, BOX_RESIST, SHOT_VALUE, SHOT_RANGE, FINISH_LOGIT, BLOCK_SCALE to reduce attempts/entries and conversion; and RESTART_PACE, SUB_STOP_S, GOAL_STOP_S, LATE_STALL to increase dead time and lower ball-in-play. Keep fouls/cards/passing dials fixed (they have big safety margins). Proposals should reduce shots and SOT while avoiding pushing in-band metrics (pass_completion, passes_per_team, goals_per_shot, xg_per_shot) out of their comfortable bands — where possible push those metrics toward the band centres (e.g. modest FINISH_LOGIT reductions to cut goals rather than only cutting shot quantity which can raise goals_per_shot).

proposals.hypothesis: A moderate, diversified step: raise LOSS to discourage risky attempts, tighten final-third and shot-range resistances to cut entries and long/low-value attempts, increase blockiness to convert some shots into blocked ones, and slightly speed restarts to reduce ball-in-play. Expect shots, SOT and goals to fall into band while leaving pass metrics and card rates largely unchanged.

Targeted reduction of high-quality opportunities: make it harder to receive in the box and reduce finishing efficiency to lower goals per match; lower shot_value to make players choosier (fewer shots). Small restart pace increase to nudge ball-in-play down. This aims to reduce goals and shots while nudging goals_per_shot/xG metrics toward the middle of their bands.

A conservative, non-shot intervention that focuses on dead time: increase restart pace and window/goal delays and add late-game stall so ball_in_play falls back into band without directly changing chance-generation dials. Safe for shot/xG/pass metrics but can bring ball_in_play down reliably.

A bolder combined move inspired by the best-performing past vectors: materially reduce final-third and near-goal success and shooting range to cut entries and close chances, lower finish to avoid converting residual chances, increase blocking, and slightly raise restart pace to shave ball-in-play. Expect a larger fall in shots, SOT, sot_share and goals, with some risk of over-shooting — this is intended as a stronger test if smaller steps fail.

diagnosis: Five metrics are outside their bands, all on the ‘too high’ side: goals_per_match (3.92 > 3.5), shots_per_team (16.44 > 14.5), sot_per_team (6.42 > 5.4), sot_share (0.3926 slightly above 0.39), and ball_in_play_min (62.30 > 61). From the history, the most reliable levers to reduce shots/SOT/goals without pushing finishing metrics up are lowering FINISH_LOGIT (reduces xG per shot and slightly reduces shot propensity) and raising BLOCK_SCALE (more blocks → lower xG per shot & fewer SOT). RESTART_PACE (and small SUB_STOP_S / GOAL_STOP_S moves) reduce ball-in-play time. BOX_RESIST and lowering SHOT_RANGE cut shots and box entries but risk dropping corners below the lower bound (trial 6 succeeded on shots/goals but corners fell). Changes to SHOT_VALUE and RESIST_* in earlier trials tended to raise goals_per_shot or xg_per_shot and have caused refusals; I will avoid SHOT_VALUE and large RESIST_* moves. SOT_share is just above the edge, so avoid aggressive changes that raise on-target share (e.g. do not reduce BLOCK_SCALE). I will propose a safe/moderate step, a stronger step, a repair of trial 6 (start from trial 6 and raise BOX_RESIST moderately), and an alternative using LOSS to test the possession-cost route.

diagnosis: Two metrics are outside their bands and need small downward moves: shots_per_team is just above its upper bound (14.58 vs 14.5) and ball_in_play_min is just above its upper bound (61.33 vs 61). Dials that reliably reduce shot volume are FINISH_LOGIT (shifts chance quality), BLOCK_SCALE, SHOT_RANGE, LOSS and SHOT_VALUE. Dead-time / stoppage dials that reduce ball-in-play are RESTART_PACE, SUB_STOP_S, TREATMENT, LATE_STALL and FOUL_RATE. Prior history shows a promising recipe (trial 6: FINISH_LOGIT -0.2, BLOCK_SCALE 1.2, SHOT_RANGE 29, RESTART_PACE 1.12) that brought shots and ball-in-play down but pushed corners below their lower bound; many proposals also pushed xg_per_shot or goals_per_shot toward edges. Therefore proposals should aim for a small reduction in shots and a small increase in dead time while protecting corners_per_team (lower edge 4.4) and xg_per_shot (upper edge 0.13).
